article.title: MYAVANA黑五活動先做AI髮質分析，再導向個人化產品選購
article.title_en: MYAVANA's Black Friday campaign puts AI hair profiling before personalized shopping
article.summary: UrbanGeekz報道，Meet MYAVANA活動以HairAI髮質分析引導產品推薦，再連接零售夥伴的選購流程。
article.summary_en: UrbanGeekz reports that Meet MYAVANA uses HairAI profiling to guide personalized product discovery and shopping through retail partners.
highlights: 用戶先建立Hair ID，再按髮質需求及天氣等背景取得推薦。
活動將於11月27至30日推動黑五至網購星期一選購；未公布銷售成效。
highlights_en: Users establish a Hair ID before recommendations based on hair needs and context such as weather.
The campaign promotes shopping for November 27–30, from Black Friday to Cyber Monday; no sales results are reported.
article.why: AI分析放在優惠之前，美容行銷團隊可決定導購入口先問哪些髮質需要，再把適合的商品與零售連結呈現給用戶。
article.why_en: Putting profiling before discounts helps beauty marketers specify which hair needs to capture before presenting products and retail links.
article.next_step: 檢視一次Hair ID到產品推薦再到零售頁的流程，列清每步使用的需求訊號，核對推薦理由與商品資料能否對應。
article.next_step_en: Review the Hair ID-to-recommendation-to-retailer journey, identify each need signal and check whether recommendation reasons match product information.
article.detail: 本篇報道的是假日活動機制，並不把11月25日當成AI助理首次推出日期。Hair ID可理解為用於產品配對的個人髮質檔案；品牌說法仍須與實際產品資料分開。編輯建議檢查推薦理由、零售連結及用戶看到的優惠是否一致，避免由個人化流程推定已改善髮質或提升轉換。這是一個AI導購案例，並非一般代言活動或已驗證成效報告。
article.detail_en: The news is the holiday activation, not a November 25 debut for the assistant. Hair ID is a profile used for product matching. Check recommendation reasons, retail links and visible offers against product information. A personalized journey does not establish improved hair condition or conversion; this is an AI shopping mechanism, not an outcomes study.
